ns0:solution.ns0:para: ⓐ Both Lydia and Marty have two phone numbers. So each x-value is not matched with only one y-value. So this relation is not a function.
ⓑ The domain is the set of all x-values in the relation. The domain is: {Lydia, Eugene, Janet, Rick, Marty}
